caption: Fig. 8. Plots (a) and (b) represents the LDA projection of segmented bolus images across the five chewing phases. The distribution conceptually reflects the progression consistent with the Mouth Process Model proposed by Hutchings and Lillford, where oral processing involve gradual structural breakdown and increasing lubrication towards swallowability (Hutchings and Lillford, 1988).
description: The figure consists of two scatter plots labeled (a) and (b), showing LDA projections of segmented bolus images across five chewing phases. The x-axis is labeled "LD1" and the y-axis "LD2" in both plots. Different colored points represent chewing phases: FinalChews, InitialChews, MidChews, and Unchewed, with distinct clusters and decision boundaries visible. The plots illustrate the progression of bolus phases consistent with the Mouth Process Model, with plot (a) showing a trajectory with vertical motion (T1) and plot (b) showing a trajectory with vertical plus shear motion (T13).
